items.title: A Defense Contractor Gave Their Personal AI Agent Access to a Secure Pentagon System
items.summary: Sources tell WIRED that an Accenture employee’s personal Claude agent ran on a DOD network for two months before it was identified and the vulnerability could be patched.
items.author: Vittoria Elliott

items.title: The ‘Pain in the Ass’ Math That Could Save Vibe Coding From Itself
items.summary: A new startup called &Truth is joining the race to automate formal verification, a painstaking process that uses math to prove software works as intended.
items.author: Paresh Dave

items.title: Mistral Says Its AI Model ‘Le Chonk’ Has Leapfrogged China in the Open-Weight Race
items.summary: The French AI lab claims its latest release matches or outperforms even the best models from DeepSeek and Z.ai in coding and cybersecurity.
items.author: Joel Khalili

items.title: I Gave My Blood to the AI Death Clock
items.summary: Death Clock promises to predict when you’re going to die and help you extend your time on Earth. After a month, I felt like it was sucking the life out of me.
items.author: Jason Parham
